ctx_alpha.reason: SSP recomputed MIC and accepted CBT

ctx_beta.reason: SSP recomputed MIC and accepted CBT

ctx_mic_flip.reason: SSP rejected the token: bad MIC

ctx_user_tamper.reason: SSP rejected the token: bad MIC over modified AUTHENTICATE

ctx_chal_tamper.reason: SSP rejected the token: bad MIC over modified CHALLENGE

ctx_cbt_tamper.reason: SSP accepted the MIC under its negotiated key then rejected channel binding (bad bindings)

ctx_no_mic.reason: SSP saw no MIC claim and applied no MIC verification

ctx_spliced.reason: SSP rejected: tokens do not belong to one conversation
